note: Modoc County and the City of Alturas (the county's only incorporated city) both zone, but publish zoning only as ordinance text and PDF zone maps (the Alturas ordinance says boundaries are on official Zone Maps). No queryable zoning district polygon layer was found on the county, city, state or ArcGIS Online. The only Modoc zone layer on ArcGIS Online (ModocZones, PHGeospatial) holds 5 emergency-management zones such as 'Zone M4', not zoning districts, so it was not submitted.
